Target audience: CareSync engineering + SRE and Redwood integration/SDK owners.

- Tue 16 Nov, 09:00–10:00
- Tue 16 Nov, 13:00–14:00
- Wed 17 Nov, 11:00–12:00

1) Quick intros + success criteria (5m)
2) Redwood hosted runtime overview & latency/cost tradeoffs (10m)
3) SDK patterns: streaming & reconnects (10m)
4) Tool/function calling and structured outputs (10m)
5) Q&A + next steps + rollouts (10–15m)

I've attached a short architecture diagram and an SDK patterns doc to help prep. Can you confirm availability and whether to include your engineering lead? Also flag any items you want added to the agenda.

Thanks —
